verdict_rationale: Every v1 design fix landed conceptually, but three load-bearing artifacts exist only as prose: the nonce-bearing launcher (the only copy of codex-agent.sh is an unversioned scratchpad file with no nonce logic), the finding schema (A6's 'blocking before Run A' commitment never made it into the spec), and the bound thresholds (N, N_MAX). REVISE would imply the design needs rework — it does not; the fixes are small, enumerable, and must land before Run A starts.
strongest_objection: The transport's fail-closed guarantee is currently fiction. The spec states as fact that 'codex-agent.sh, the probe script, and its transcript are committed to the output root so the claim is reproducible rather than reported' — but nothing is committed: the entire output root is untracked (git status shows '?? docs/plans/2026-07-26-deep-review/'), git ls-files returns nothing for it, and no codex-agent.sh has ever been committed on any ref (git log --all --diff-filter=A -- '*codex-agent*' is empty). The only copy of codex-agent.sh on this machine sits in a session-scoped scratchpad (~/.cctmp/claude-501/-Users-trent-Documents-dev-ledrums/748ebb42-.../scratchpad/) alongside the probe transcripts, and grep confirms it contains no nonce or provenance logic at all. So the single mitigation the spec calls 'fail-closed, not prompt-dependent' is unimplemented anywhere, its host script is subject to scratchpad garbage collection, and every phase that routes through a wrapper (1, 2, 5, 7, 8) would run today with the transport's worst failure mode — silent wrapper self-answer — completely unguarded. The spec's reproducibility claim is false at current HEAD, and if that scratchpad is cleaned, the transport primitive and the probe evidence vanish with it.

D1_soundness.why: Anchor 2: works in the common case with an unaddressed failure path — the per-lens acceptance criteria contain unbound parameters ('≥N lines', '≥N files') and the Phase 3 admission cap is an unset symbol (N_MAX), so refuters on two lenses and the cap itself still improvise, which is the exact failure A1 was accepted to eliminate.

D2_completeness.why: Anchor 2: an output shape a downstream phase cannot rely on — the finding schema that Phase 3 prompts read, Phase 4 keys off, and Phase 10 renders from is named load-bearing but defined nowhere, and the Seams contract omits 03-refuted.json, which Phase 3a mandates producing.

D3_cost_realism.why: Anchor 3: realistic, dominant cost identified (Phase 3 Opus-high), a knob offered (refuter count), counts explicitly demoted to formulas over I with a Phase 0 calibration step to replace extrapolations; row arithmetic now sums correctly to 79–100 (verified).

D4_failure_modes.why: Anchor 2: named, but a mitigation is asserted rather than demonstrated — the nonce attestation is the mitigation for the transport's named worst failure mode and it is implemented nowhere; the scratchpad codex-agent.sh has no nonce logic.

D5_evidence.why: Anchor 0: a load-bearing claim is contradicted by the repo — 'codex-agent.sh, the probe script, and its transcript are committed to the output root' is false at HEAD ed07b29; the output root is entirely untracked and the script exists only in an unversioned scratchpad.

D6_scope.why: Anchor 3: tight, each phase has an identified consumer; execution excluded, rejected transports documented with reasons. (Both r1 reviewers scored 3; nothing found this round changes it, though the spec shows removal evidence mostly by reference to v1 rather than in-text, holding it at 3 not 4.)

Schema written before Run A', but SPEC.md contains neither a schema definition nor any statement blocking Run A on its existence (grep for schema/blocking/'runs A' finds only references to a schema that does not exist).

Caveat filed as F3: two criteria contain an unbound N, so the fix is incomplete for Duplicated Code and Divergent Change.

Phase 3 is split into 3a (adversarial refutation, refuted-under-uncertainty) and 3b (positive mechanical verification with non-model evidence); 'Only findings passing 3a and 3b reach Phase 5 auto-fix' and 3a-only survivors route to the structural-plan track as hypotheses. The only codex-agent.sh on this machine is untracked scratchpad (~/.cctmp/.../748ebb42-.../scratchpad/codex-agent.sh); grep -i 'nonce|provenance' against it returns nothing. SPEC.md contains no schema definition, no schema file exists in the output root, and no statement blocks Run A on the schema's existence — the only mentions are references to a schema assumed to exist (§Solution line 47, §Seams line 364). Its enforcement keys off schema fields that do not yet exist (A6), so it inherits that dependency.

Row arithmetic verified: 3+3+25+10+10+14+8+6+0 = 79, 3+3+45+10+10+14+8+6+1 = 100. Caveat filed as F3: N_MAX has no value and no procedure for choosing one.

Phase 3a: refuted findings 'retained in 03-refuted.json rather than discarded — they are the only measure of the gate's false-negative rate'. Caveat filed as F4: the Seams artifact listing was not updated and still shows only 03-verdicts.json.

Rejection incorporated correctly and accurately: the spec now states caps live in ~/.zshenv (2) with with-gate-lock.mjs supplying ??=4 as an in-lock floor only when unset, and that a repo-only search finds nothing. All three statements verified against the actual ~/.zshenv (MAX_THREADS=2, MAX_FORKS=2, live in current env), with-gate-lock.mjs lines 106–111, and git ls-files (no vitest.config.*). Note: the ~/.zshenv comment itself still references the deleted scripts/test-lock.sh — environment doc drift, not a spec defect.

Rejection upheld; no spec change was required and none regressed. Phase table verified internally consistent under I=6: Phase 7 = 18 lanes = 12 native + 6 Sol batched into 2 wrappers = 14 agents; Phase 8 = 12 reviews = 6 native Fable + 2 Sol wrappers = 8; Phase 9 = 6. The warning box additionally converts all three to formulas over I.

The narrowing landed in text — 'Proxy routing is proven… Wrapper fidelity was not, and the nonce is what proves it' — but the evidence making routing 'proven' (probe script and transcript) is not committed; the transcripts (p0.txt, probe-exports.txt, probe-protocol.txt) exist only in the same unversioned scratchpad as codex-agent.sh. The claim is currently reported, not reproducible, which is the exact defect A3's fix was meant to close.

findings.quote: codex-agent.sh, the probe script, and its transcript are committed to the output root so the claim is reproducible rather than reported.
findings.claim: This present-tense claim is false, and the nonce mitigation it anchors is implemented nowhere — the A3 fix did not land (adjudication id A3).
findings.failure_scenario: Run A starts. The workflow's wrappers invoke the scratchpad copy of codex-agent.sh (the only copy in existence, at ~/.cctmp/claude-501/-Users-trent-Documents-dev-ledrums/748ebb42-.../scratchpad/), which contains no nonce or provenance logic — grep confirms. Wrapper self-answer is therefore undetectable across Phases 1, 2, 5, 7, and 8, exactly the 'confident answer from the wrong model with no error surfaced' failure the spec names. Alternatively, scratchpad GC runs first and the transport primitive plus all probe evidence are deleted outright, making even the routing proof unrecoverable. Additionally the entire output root — including this spec — is untracked, so a git clean -fd destroys the initiative; user stories 15 and 37 ('survives the sessions') are unmet.
findings.would_change_my_mind: git ls-files showing codex-agent.sh, the probe script, and a transcript tracked under docs/plans/2026-07-26-deep-review/, with the script containing nonce generation and the workflow script containing the corresponding validator.
findings.recommendation: Before Run A: implement the nonce in codex-agent.sh, move it and the probe artifacts into the output root, commit the whole directory, and change the spec sentence to name the tracked paths.

findings.quote: The finding schema (`02`) is the load-bearing one: Phase 3's prompts read it, Phase 4's split keys off it, Phase 10's table renders from it.
findings.claim: The schema is referenced as load-bearing but defined nowhere, and A6's adjudicated 'blocking before Run A' condition appears nowhere in the spec (adjudication id A6).
findings.failure_scenario: Run A reaches Phase 2 with no schema artifact and nothing in the spec halting it. Eleven lens lanes each emit their own ad-hoc finding shape; Phase 3 prompts have no criterion field to read, Phase 4's deterministic JS cannot key a triage off inconsistent shapes, and the per-lens acceptance criteria (A1's fix) and the auto-fix ineligibility rule (A7's fix) are both unenforceable because both are specified as schema-recorded fields.
findings.would_change_my_mind: A schema file tracked in the output root plus a spec line making its existence a precondition of Run A.
findings.recommendation: Write the finding schema file (fields: lens, acceptance criterion applied, evidence, size, blast radius, interface delta), commit it, and add to §Run chunking: 'Run A does not start until the finding schema and nonce-bearing launcher are tracked.'

findings.spec_section: Solution (acceptance criteria table) and Phases → Phase 3 (admission cap)
findings.quote: Duplicated Code | ≥2 sites, ≥N lines … Divergent Change / Shotgun Surgery | One logical change requires edits in ≥N files … Phase 3 accepts at most `N_MAX` findings
findings.claim: Three load-bearing thresholds are unbound symbols — N (twice) and N_MAX have no values and no procedure for setting them, so criteria marked 'mechanical ✅' are not mechanically applicable.
findings.failure_scenario: Two Phase 3 refuters evaluate duplicated-code findings; one treats N as 5 lines, the other as 30. Their verdicts diverge on identical evidence and both are rubric-compliant — the criteria improvisation A1 was accepted to eliminate, now hidden behind a variable name. Meanwhile the admission cap cannot drop anything because N_MAX is never assigned, so either the cap silently never binds or the workflow author picks a number ad hoc at launch, unrecorded.
findings.would_change_my_mind: Concrete values (or a Phase 0 step that fixes them from calibration data and records them in 00-baseline.md) for N in both lenses and for N_MAX.
findings.recommendation: Bind all three: state the values in the table, or add 'set and record N and N_MAX in 00-baseline.md' to Phase 0 so refuter prompts and the cap read recorded values.

findings.claim: The seam contract was not updated for the v2 changes: it omits 03-refuted.json (mandated by Phase 3a), and gives no tracked home to codex-agent.sh, the probe transcript, or the finding schema — the very artifacts v2 promises are committed.
findings.failure_scenario: A Phase 3 implementer builds to the seam listing (the stated interface), writes only 03-verdicts.json, and discards refuted findings — silently reverting A10. The false-negative-rate measurement the spec calls 'the only measure of the gate's false-negative rate' never exists, and nobody notices because the artifact contract was satisfied.
findings.would_change_my_mind: A seam listing that includes 03-refuted.json and paths for the schema, launcher, and probe artifacts.
findings.recommendation: Add 03-refuted.json, the finding-schema file, codex-agent.sh, and the probe transcript to the Seams listing so the contract matches the phase text.
